text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I really am just cursed with the worst
timing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I finally discovered a great runner to scout
at the latest round of
tryout races, but
before I had a chance to even call out to
her, she
had made a contract with another
trainer.
Wow, now that was a huge sigh.

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haha! My bad, my bad! Did I scare ya? I
was just catchin' some Z's
over there in the
shade, so I couldn't help but notice.

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And it's so over, you say? Wanna chat
about the impending calamity?
I bet just
talkin' about it will take a load off.

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh I see, I see, that so? Guess you're
having trouble on the job, then.
Or maybe
you peeped some kinda deep dark secret
that the
academy's trying to hide?!

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Okay, yeah, makes sense. Bein' a
trainer does seem pretty
tough. Do you
have a trainee you're looking out for at the
moment?

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So you missed your shot at a protégé,
then. What else is buggin'
ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, she gets to the core of my
struggle. I have to admit
that I can feel the
weight lifting from my shoulders with each
passing
question.

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So now that you've relaxed a bit, why not
check out the next round of
tryouts?

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll be lookin' for ya, then! Cuz get
this—I'm gonna be running
in it!

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And not just that—it's gonna be my very
first time! Piques your
interest, yeah? Or
not! Listen to me try to give a sales pitch!
Come on
out if you feel like it, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She tells me all of this with a playful smile.
I can't help but feel a little
intrigued.

text_block_list.name: Cheery Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What, you wanna know? The name's—

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I bet everyone's got their eyes on Mejiro
Ryan today! She looks to be
in great form,
too. I'm expecting great things!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and that girl next to her is also a
Mejiro, right? Mejiro...
something or
other... She's looking kind of slack in
comparison.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I met on the rooftop that
day is a member of the
prestigious Mejiro
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family is quite renowned for
fostering Umamusume of
outstanding
repute.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among the current generation are talented
runners like Mejiro Ryan
and Mejiro
McQueen. They've created quite the buzz
ever since
joining the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, you came! Looking forward to
hearing some cheers, 'specially
since I'll be
running my butt off!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't think I'll be getting nearly as much
attention as Ryan, though.
Haha, couldn't
even begin to match her, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But yeah, just you watch. I'm a Mejiro too,
after all. I'm gonna show
everyone today
that I'm worthy of bearing the name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She remains just as upbeat as she was
earlier, but I can sense the
tiniest bit of
unease in her expression. With that, she
takes her place
at the starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer runs in the lead. At a
glance, it does look as if she's
adopted a
model winning strategy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as the race nears its end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Now! Haaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's steadily passed by many runners
making their final spurts for the
finish. I
can see the struggle in her expression as
that wonderful form
begins to fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's almost like she's running too by the book, and playing it safe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Ahhh, you're kidding! Last place?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What're they gonna think of me? That
wasn't Mejiro-like at all!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd easily take first! The Mejiro
name really means
something, huh? Do
you mind if I had a word?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yep, you're a Mejiro through and through!
We could use someone as
strong as you on
our team!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, uh... I'll get to you all, but can we
talk over there? We'll clog
up the stands
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haha! Why was I so worried about living up to the Mejiro name? It's not like anyone was even calling my name!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I got way too worked up about
all this. How am I gonna
disappoint anyone
if they aren't even acknowledging me to
start?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Honestly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... Haha! Hey hey! Enjoy the race?
End up spotting anyone
you're interested
in? I bet Ryan's at the top of your list,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, I get it. The Mejiro
family is brimming with so
much other
talent, it's only natural that someone like
me isn't on
everyone's radar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But it's not like I'm giving up or anything,
ya know? If I don't have
what it takes to
stand out now, then I've got no choice but
to kick it
into even higher gear. No time to
get all emo and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Gonna get back to training right after this,
actually. I'll start back at
the basics and
build more stamina, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What I witnessed during that race was
surely a sense of pressure.
Pressure to run
"like a Mejiro."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a result, her running felt stiff. It's fine to
run while staying true to
the basics, but...
In truth, that doesn't suit everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A style more suited to me? What
does...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Oh uh, thanks! I'll have to think about
that then.
